defectsFixed.fact: FlushValidatedFrontBuffer and ScheduleFrontPacketValidation used chained acquisition and unconditional release calls in failure paths, which weakened proof that each ReleaseWriteLock matched a successful acquire.
defectsFixed.fix: Both paths now use explicit acquired flags and release only buffers actually locked.

defectsFixed.fact: Every PhysicsApplySystem force/velocity/pose packet called GlobalPhysicsStateManager.RegisterTrackedBody, which can rescan culling components and refresh DTO state even when the body is already tracked.
defectsFixed.fix: PhysicsApplySystem packet routes now call RegisterTrackedBodyIfMissing, a cached-manager/dictionary fast path that performs full registration only for untracked bodies.

defectsFixed.fact: Tracked-body registration and lane removal published _lastValidPositions, PhysicsCullingDTO, FrozenVelocityDTO, and state-age lanes through multiple independent indexer-lock writes.
defectsFixed.fix: Registration and removal now acquire one scoped tracked-body lane mutation lock set for LastValidPositions, CullingDTO, FrozenVelocity, and StateAge, releasing in finally.
